featured_reviews.name: akanksha karkhanis
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Kibo Project — The more I try to write about this place, the more I feel words fall short.
I came across this medical centre very recently when a small pup, Lisa, met with a road accident. We rushed her there and were told that she would need complete cage rest and medical attention for around 15 days. At first, I was hesitant and anxious. So many questions kept running through my mind — Would they take good care of her? What if something went wrong? What if she didn’t recover well?
But today, after a week, I can proudly say that every one of my worries has been proven wrong, thanks to Ankita and the incredible team there (I’m sorry I don’t know everyone’s names). They have been taking such wonderful care of Lisa and giving her all the medical attention she needs. The improvement in her condition is already visible.
And it’s not just Lisa — the entire team looks after all the doggos and cattos there with so much love and dedication. I’ve honestly never seen such a clean and hygienic centre before. Everyone works tirelessly, round the clock, for the little world they have built for these animals.
Lisa has also made some adorable friends there — Bittey, Motor, Sarah, and Blackcurrant ❤️
Thank you so much to all of you, and kudos for the incredible work you’re doing. Much love!!!

featured_reviews.name: Rita Varma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I trusted Kibo with my cat, Chittu, for a few days of fluid therapy and oral medication, and it turned out to be one of the worst decisions I’ve made. I had heard good things about them, but my experience was nothing short of traumatic.

Throughout Chittu’s stay, getting updates was incredibly difficult. They only sent pictures after I repeatedly asked, and even those updates didn’t reflect the reality of what my baby was going through. A couple of days later, I noticed bruising in one of the photos, which made me feel something was seriously wrong so I went to pick him up.

What I saw broke me.
My cat had bruises in multiple places, even around the neck. He smelled strongly of urine, as if he had been left lying in it. His fur and skin were in terrible condition, and he was severely dehydrated. The updates they gave me were completely misleading compared to his actual state.

I had provided all his oral medications, yet they were returned to me unopened. This means none of his medications were given, which could have significantly contributed to his decline. His IV catheter wasn’t changed for days, causing phlebitis and bruising at the site, something that no responsible clinic should overlook.

Because of the condition Chittu was in when I brought him home, I was forced to make the heartbreaking decision of putting him to sleep. I cannot express the pain of knowing my baby could have had more time and comfort, but that chance was taken away from him.

Although I understood that my pet’s blood values didn’t indicate a good prognosis, I still believed he deserved every possible chance at recovery. Working in the medical field myself, I’ve seen many patients improve when the right line of treatment is followed. As a pet parent, my only wish was for him to receive proper care, comfort, and hygiene especially towards the end of his life.

Unfortunately, Kibo failed to provide even that basic dignity. What should have been compassionate, attentive care turned into a deeply disappointing and hurtful experience.

I trusted Kibo, and they failed my baby in every possible way. I will never forgive the negligence and lack of basic care that cost my cat his remaining time. I would not recommend this place to anyone who loves their pet.

featured_reviews.name: Sid Kolwankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
🐈 Flight of Pheonix 🐈

I found a this ginger kitten near Phoenix Mall, Kurla, in a very critical condition. He was barely able to walk, covered in flies, and refusing to eat. I reached out to several animal NGOs, but no one responded or picked up my calls.
Then I called Kibo Project, and to my relief, they immediately picked up and accepted the cat. I honestly didn’t think he would make it, but the Kibo team Riya, Abhishek, Vaibhav and Dr. Atharva showed incredible dedication. They kept me updated daily with photos and health reports of the kitten, whom I named Phoenix after the mall.
Over the next 18 days, I visited them a few times and even brought food for all the cats at their shelter. I’m so grateful that Phoenix fully recovered, was vaccinated and dewormed, and was released back near the mall yesterday, 3rd December.
The entire team’s commitment made all the difference. Thank you to Pragya for founding such an essential NGO. This world needs more people like you. I will always be thankful to Kibo Project for giving Phoenix a second chance at life.

featured_reviews.name: Tara Kapur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have been to Kibo several times despite its fairly recent opening.

Our group, Bandra Volunteers, has several dogs and one cat there, at present.

The premises are clean and well ventilated and the team is responsive, caring and kind.

They are good in taking dogs and cats to the vet for follow up and in medical rehab like wound dressing, feeding medicines etc.

More importantly, they provide updates on appetite, healing and progress and are proactive in suggesting neutering, vaccination before release, etc

Thanks Team Kibo Project for providing us with a much needed quality service for our community animals.

Strongly recommended if you are looking for a medical rehab.

Separately, they have great merchandise like notebooks and tees, which you can purchase to support their work.

featured_reviews.name: Poornima Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the behaviour of the hospital staff. Today, a stray cat from our building was in severe labor pain, and we brought her for urgent help. Instead of showing compassion, one lady staff member was extremely rude, loud, and shouting at us. She clearly did not want to provide treatment.

This is not the first time such careless behaviour has happened here. Because of the delay and lack of support, the cat suffered terribly and sadly lost one of her babies. It was heartbreaking to witness.

Hospitals, especially medical staff, are expected to show humanity and basic kindness — whether it is for people or animals. Such behaviour damages the reputation of the hospital. Strict action should be taken against such staff members so that no one else has to face this again.

customer_updates.name: Vijay Patil
customer_updates.text:
ज़रूरी सूचना / Urgent Notice
हिन्दी:
नमस्ते,
मैंने एक कुत्ते को देखा है जिसे तुरंत मदद की ज़रूरत है।
कुत्ते की स्थिति:
* वह बीमार दिख रहा है।
* वह अस्वाभाविक रूप से व्यवहार कर रहा था (मेरे पीछे आ रहा था, दूसरे कुत्तों पर हमला कर रहा था)।
* उसके मुँह से लार या झाग निकल रहा था।
* वह बहुत आक्रामक लग रहा था।
कृपया जल्द से जल्द इसकी मदद करें।
धन्यवाद।
English:
Hello,
I have seen a dog that urgently needs help.
Dog's Condition:
* It appears to be sick.
* It was behaving unusually (following me, attacking other dogs).
* There was saliva or foam coming from its mouth.
* It seemed very aggressive.
Please provide assistance as soon as possible.
Thank you.
मराठी:
नमस्कार,
मला एक कुत्रा दिसला आहे ज्याला त्वरित मदतीची गरज आहे.
कुत्र्याची स्थिती:
* तो आजारी दिसत आहे.
* तो असामान्यपणे वागत होता (माझ्या मागे येत होता, इतर कुत्र्यांवर हल्ला करत होता).
* त्याच्या तोंडातून लाळ किंवा फेस बाहेर येत होता.
* तो खूप आक्रमक वाटत होता.
कृपया लवकरच याला मदत करा.
धन्यवाद.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This NGO truly sets a gold standard in social service. Their team is upfront, proactive, and available 24×7, which is rare and incredibly reassuring. No matter the time or situation, they step in immediately and take responsibility rather than making excuses.

What really stands out is their willingness to go the extra mile—sometimes even beyond what is expected or required—to ensure real help reaches those in need. Their work is driven by compassion, transparency, and action, not just words.

It’s organizations like this that restore faith in humanity. Deep respect and gratitude to the entire team for their tireless dedication and selfless service. Highly recommended and truly trustworthy. 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Bala Jogale
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience with Animal Rescue and Shelter Foundation. They took very good care of my three cats, making sure they were well-fed, comfortable, and safe. The shelter was clean and hygienic, and the team was very kind and caring towards the animals. I truly appreciate their dedication and would definitely recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: namrata katwankar
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you for the incredible work you do for helpless kittens and abandoned animals. Your kindness, care, and dedication are truly inspiring. Because of your efforts, many innocent lives get a second chance to live safely and happily. The world really needs more people and foundations like yours. Keep doing this amazing work. 🐾❤️

featured_reviews.name: Azim Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank this animal shelter enough for the incredible help they gave me during a very stressful night. When I was in urgent need and didn’t know where to turn, they stepped in with compassion, professionalism, and genuine care for my Labrador.

Even at night, their team was responsive, calm, and incredibly kind. They treated my dog as if he were their own, which immediately put me at ease. In a moment of panic, their support meant everything to me.

This shelter isn’t just a place for animals — it’s a place full of people with big hearts who truly care. I’ll always be grateful for their night-time help and would highly recommend them to anyone who needs support for their pet in an emergency.

featured_reviews.name: Pratiksha Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I do NOT recommend this rescue service at all.
I found a small puppy on the road and took care of him for almost a month with proper food and attention. Trusting them, I handed him over for rescue, as they assured me of proper care, checkup, and vaccination.
However, after they took the puppy, they completely stopped answering calls and messages. When we personally visited their location later, we were shocked to see the puppy’s condition had become much worse. There was no proper care, no medical treatment, and no vaccination as promised.
This is extremely irresponsible and heartbreaking. Please do not trust them with any animal’s life. Animals deserve love and proper care, not neglect like this.

featured_reviews.name: dhiraj tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when help is needed not tomorrow, not in the morning—but right now. This NGO was a true lifesaver for me at midnight, when I had almost lost hope. They didn’t just respond quickly; they responded with genuine care, empathy, and respect.

A very special mention to Bhavesh, the real protagonist who stepped in and treated me with incredible hospitality and kindness. He made sure I felt safe, supported, and heard—something you never forget in times of distress.

This organization doesn’t just “help” people; they stand by you when it matters most. If you’re ever in need or looking to support an NGO that truly makes a difference on the ground, I wholeheartedly recommend them. Eternal gratitude 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: Manisha Pal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Mr mohan he is very helpful...
He saved 2 kitties from our area came for immediate assistance formalities were very smooth.. one of the best organisation for animal rescue and adoption center..

featured_reviews.name: Khushi Kachalia
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a stray kitten that no one was willing to adopt, her mom had died and we just picked her up off the street with no knowledge of how to care for her. We couldn't keep her because we could not transport her back to our home, and we already had a dog. She had fleas and worms and we were terrified about what to do for her. We called ARAS in the morning and they got back to us immediately and in the next 2-3 hours the founder came to pick her up. He even explained that you may video call the foundation or request pictures to check in on the animal. The work these people are doing is incredible, and the complaints about the request for donations is completely unjustified. Pets are expensive, these people are paying rent for a property as well as feeding, grooming, and giving medical care to over some 60 animals. A big thank you to Bhavesh Jain and everyone else working for this foundation ! As for Ginger, I hope someone will adopt her, she's very sweet, loves to cuddle and only 1.5-2 months old. There are pictures of her below, and if you are interested go ahead and give this number a call. 😄

featured_reviews.review_text: We got our European-American mix Doberman male puppy from Sagar via another Dog breeder on 21 April. Before buying, I did some research on good Dog breeders/suppliers in the Mumbai area. Sagar Kennels seems to have very high rating and I am very happy with the service. He is knowledgeable, helpful and more importantly honest. We got our puppy within 24 hours of booking. The puppy is very playful and visibly well maintained. We got his first vaccination done. He is now 63 days old and enjoying the company of our 11 years old Yellow Labrador.

featured_reviews.review_text: I came across Sagar online when i was searching for a reputed dog breeder. He was very patient and helpful answering all the queries i had regarding dog's. I decided to go for a Beagle pup which was not bred in captivity. He recommended a few puppies and i chose one which was bred in a hygiene surrounding and the puppies mother which was also well looked after. I bought home a cute Beagle pup 45 days old. The puppy is very active, full of energy and has adapted well to his new home. Unmissable is the natural anchor around the puppies neck.Thank you Sagar for helping me get a healthy and cute puppy.

The Beagle puppy I brought home is vibrant, energetic, and has seamlessly adapted to its new environment. A distinctive feature is the natural markings around the puppy’s neck, which add to its charm. I am truly grateful to Sagar for his guidance and for providing me with a healthy, delightful puppy. I highly recommend his services to anyone seeking a well-cared-for pet.

featured_reviews.name: Muskaan Arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best and genuine animal welfare NGOs I’ve come across. I discovered them in 2021 and have seen them grow tremendously over time. What makes them truly special is their team - including school and college students, working professionals, and dedicated animal lovers across age groups, all coming together for a common cause.

I’ve had the opportunity to closely work with the team, and their dedication is truly commendable. Animal welfare isn’t easy, it involves making tough and critical decisions but they continue to give their best and often go out of their way to help animals. Truly inspiring work!

featured_reviews.name: richa sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt thank you to Founder Sushank and CAP Organisation for giving this sweet soul the better life she truly deserved. From severe skin infection to healing and hope, Mili’s transformation (before and after pic) says it all. She is a street dog near our apartment, and today she has a new chance at life. Every soul on the streets deserves love, dignity, and care, and CAP continues to serve this cause in every way they can.

This is not the only case they have helped us with—they have supported 2–3 more dogs as well, always stepping in selflessly. They never asked us for donations for treatment, but we felt it was our responsibility to contribute and support such genuine work.

Requesting everyone to please support them in whatever way possible. They may not have big backing, but they have big hearts. ♥️

featured_reviews.name: Meera Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
A 12-year-old dog from my college had a uterine prolapse, and when no one else responded or was ready to help, CAP Foundation immediately stepped in. They took her in, made sure she got the surgery she needed, and cared for her through the entire recovery.
The team was so kind, responsive, and genuinely concerned about her well-being. They kept her till she fully healed and treated her with so much love and patience.
Truly grateful for everything they did, CAP didn’t just help my dog heal, they gave her comfort and dignity when she needed it most.🙌

name: The Pets Planet
description: We are a non-profit, no kill shelter for all breeds of dogs and cats. We are a caring stray and pet animals shelter situated right 9n the cost of Manori Jetty Malad west. Founded in June 2002, we rescue and care for homeless animals. Most of the dogs and cats that we take in are from high kill facilities that are euthanizing due to lack of space. Many have been abused, neglected or abandoned . Once rehabilitated and ready, they are carefully matched with prospective adopters and placed in loving homes. We do take in some owner relinquishments as well and there are a variety of reasons people give up their dog or cat to us. The most common reasons are lack of time due to a change in work schedule, moving, allergies, new baby etc.

featured_reviews.name: Deepali Sengupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sometimes you come across a place that quietly restores your faith in kindness. In Defense of Animals (IDA) in Deonar, Mumbai, is one of those rare places. For over two decades, they’ve been caring for animals who have been abandoned, injured, blind, or living with disabilities — and here, they’re not just treated… they are truly seen. They are fed, healed, and given a chance to feel safe again.
Watching the IDA team care for these little souls with such patience and compassion is deeply moving. Their work is gentle, honest, and full of heart, and it reminds you how powerful simple kindness can be.
Sharing this because such goodness deserves to be acknowledged. And if anyone ever feels like extending even a small gesture of support, IDA is a place where it truly reaches those who need it most. ❤️
